user.title: Connect to Microsoft Exchange
user.description: Read-only access to calendars on an on-premises Exchange Server (2013–2019, SE) via Exchange Web Services. Exchange Online (Microsoft 365) is not supported.

data_description.url: Host name (mail.example.com) or the full EWS URL (https://mail.example.com/EWS/Exchange.asmx).
data_description.username: Usually your e-mail address or DOMAIN\username.
data_description.auth_method: Automatic picks NTLM when the server offers it, otherwise Basic.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for servers with a self-signed or internal certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Exchange password changed
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the password for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the username or password. Check them by signing in to Outlook on the web before trying again: repeated failures may lock the account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EWS endpoint. Check the server address and that EWS is enabled for your account.
error.ssl_error: The server certificate could not be verified. If the server uses a self-signed or internal certificate, turn off certificate verification.
error.no_auth_method: The server offers neither NTLM nor Basic authentication.
error.ews_error: Exchange returned an error. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

user.title: Add a shared calendar
user.description: Calendar of another mailbox (a colleague, a room, a shared mailbox) that this account is allowed to read.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the mailbox address.

error.access_denied: This account has no permission to read that calendar.
error.invalid_auth: The account password is no longer valid. Reauthenticate the account first.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Exchange server.
error.ssl_error: The server certificate could not be verified.
error.no_auth_method: The server offers neither NTLM nor Basic authentication.
error.ews_error: Exchange returned an error. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: Exchange calendar options
init.description: Apply to every calendar of this account.

data.days_ahead: Days ahead to keep in cache

data_description.days_ahead: Events further ahead are still fetched on demand, e.g. when browsing the calendar.
data_description.include_description: Meeting body as plain text (often contains the online meeting link). One extra request per 50 events.
